coverage_note: Municipal, county, school and district employees under the Municipal Public Employees Labor Relations Law, 26 M.R.S. chapter 9-A. State employees (chapter 9-B), University of Maine System employees (chapter 12) and judicial employees (chapter 14) have parallel statutes administered by the same board; they are cited here only where noted.

governing_statute.value: Municipal Public Employees Labor Relations Law, 26 M.R.S. sections 961 to 975 (chapter 9-A)
governing_statute.quote: it is the purpose of this chapter to promote the improvement of the relationship between public employers and their employees by providing a uniform basis for recognizing the right of public employees to join labor organizations of their own choosing and to be represented by such organizations in collective bargaining for terms and conditions of employment.

scope_of_bargaining.value: Wages, hours, working conditions and contract grievance arbitration. Teachers' employers meet and consult but do not negotiate on educational policies, except preparation and planning time and transfers, which are permissive.
scope_of_bargaining.quote: C. To confer and negotiate in good faith with respect to wages, hours, working conditions and contract grievance arbitration, except that by such obligation neither party may be compelled to agree to a proposal or be required to make a concession

impasse_procedure.value: Mediation, then fact-finding, then interest arbitration. Arbitration awards are advisory on salaries, pensions and insurance, and binding on other subjects.
impasse_procedure.quote: With respect to a controversy over salaries, pensions and insurance, the arbitrators shall recommend terms of settlement and may make findings of fact; those recommendations and findings are advisory only

agency_fee_status.value: Not collectible. Chapter 9-A bars employers from requiring membership or disciplining employees for not paying dues or fees, and Janus v. AFSCME (2018) bars agency fees from nonconsenting public employees. The state-employee chapter still contains pre-Janus service-fee text (26 M.R.S. 979-B(2)), which Janus makes unenforceable.
agency_fee_status.quote: H. Terminating or disciplining an employee for not paying union dues or fees of any type.

dfr_forum.value: Maine Labor Relations Board. The certified agent must represent all unit employees without regard to membership, and prohibited-practice complaints against employee organizations are processed by the board.
dfr_forum.quote: The bargaining agent certified by the executive director of the board as the exclusive bargaining agent shall represent all the public employees within the unit without regard to membership in the organization certified as bargaining agent
